challenge.results: The heading identifies edition 1.2. The 1.1 reference occurs in an appendix list, and “only” occurs in an example of wording a licensor might use. Neither identifies a different edition or variant of this document. The introductory text refers to a particular Work and the licensor’s notice or other expression of willingness. It supplies no project-wide evidence. The lifecycle row matches the Commission text capture and explicitly limits the decision to it.

limitations: The finding covers one captured representation. Byte or legal equivalence with EUR-Lex, translations and other publisher texts remains unestablished. The earlier EUR-Lex acquisition failed and supplies no qualifying evidence.
